name: aparena
description: ApArena — 9 modular preparation banks with glassmorphism, indexed-but-hidden topics

scripts.build:css: python3 -c "import re,pathlib; p=pathlib.Path('css/style.css'); c=p.read_text(); c=re.sub(r'/\*.*?\*/','',c,flags=re.S); c=re.sub(r'\s+',' ',c); c=re.sub(r'\s*([{}:;,])\s*',r'\1',c); pathlib.Path('css/style.min.css').write_text(c); print(f'minified {len(c)}')"
scripts.build: npm run build:banks && npm run build:css
